notes: Issue #356 posted 176 San Francisco listings from the Blackbird app (data gathered by hand and converted to JSON by an LLM); 42 of them carried a street address as filed — the issue's own text says "Street addresses past Little Sweet in Financial District will need to be researched", and this batch is those 42. One, Alora Coastal Mediterranean, gives "Pier 3, Hornblower Landing" rather than a numbered street address; it does not parse against EAS and is left out of the findings entirely, so 41 were checked. 38 resolved to an active parcel and are published here. Three did not: 3108 Fillmore Street (Angela's Ice Cream) spans two parcels in sf-eas-addresses today and the record does not say which; 191 Warriors Way (Dumpling Time) is a condominium, which the occupants rule in the root AGENTS.md defers to a human establishing the building's parcel set; and 1796 Union Street (Avotoasty) is addressed on a blklot that carries no shape of its own on sf-parcels (its shape is keyed to mapblklot 0529089, which is 2804 Octavia Street) and has no row on the 2025 roll — a merged-lot case, not a missing-roll-row case, and it needs a human's judgement before a page is seeded. The remaining 134 listings in issue #356 carry no address at all. www.blackbird.xyz's own site is not a way to list them: its sitemap names only about fifty curated /spots pages nationwide (roughly a dozen in San Francisco), each carrying a structured address in the page's Next.js data rather than a directory listing, and it does not cover the app's full San Francisco merchant list the way Bites' or Ritual's own listings do. So the second half merchants/AGENTS.md requires before a ticket is workable — a way to list the directory's San Francisco locations — is still missing for those 134, the same gap issue #356 itself flagged, and they need a human to supply addresses before they can be checked against EAS. The referral credential is real: https://app.blackbird.xyz/r/bb-98v7tj. Its own landing page states the reward as "2,000 $FLY" and, directly under that, "(2,000 Fly is equivalent to $20 USD)" — confirming the issue's "$20 after first purchase," so the REFERRALS row states it in dollars rather than a currency ("Fly") a reader has never heard of. The link never reaches a merchant — it opens Blackbird's mobile download screen — so the row carries a note. Three of the 38 — Little Sweet at 1253 9th Avenue, 3836 Geary Boulevard and 75 O'Farrell Street — are already on their pages from Ritual, read 2026-09-11, four days before this batch. The occupants rule says the more recently read directory's facts win; taken literally here that would replace Ritual's cuisines and opening hours with nothing, since the issue carries neither, which is a page getting less true rather than more current. `source` stays `ritual` on those three and `blackbird` joins `also_listed_by`, the same shape a rotating list without its own occupancy facts already gets (HotelTonight, merchants/AGENTS.md) — a human should confirm this reading.

coverage.remaining: 134 listings in issue #356 carry no address and need one from a human before they can be checked against EAS (Blackbird's own site lists only a small curated subset with addresses, not the full directory). Alora Coastal Mediterranean's "Pier 3, Hornblower Landing" is not a numbered address and was not checked. Three addressed listings did not resolve and need a human's judgement: 3108 Fillmore Street (two candidate parcels), 191 Warriors Way (condominium), 1796 Union Street (merged lot, no roll row).
